name: Created
importNotes: Imported from the Created Training Center Equipment sheet, then given a floor ID for every row.
IDs are a section letter plus a three-digit row number: L lower, U upper, T trunk, B total body, F free weight, C cardio, R restorative, Z business. L001 is Lower Extremity row 1.
The sheet IDs L1, L2, and L3 are legacy aliases of L001, L002, and L003. aliases maps the old code to the floor ID.
The L001 guide is the printed Machine Guide placard for the Nautilus 2ST Hip Extension (Super Glute Machine). Sheet columns stay on the record; placard sentences live under guide.
Business Equipment type and method cells repeat the Restorative Equipment rows and look pasted into the wrong columns. The exported text is unchanged.
Name-only rows, and the three identical Nautilus Dumbbell Rack lines, are kept as separate entries.

guide.title: HIP EXTENSION MACHINE
guide.setup: Pad at 11 o'clock. Hips at red dot. Belt on.
guide.movement: Drive legs straight. Pause. Slow return.
guide.caution: Control it. Challenge yourself. Smooth reps, no momentum.
